note: New State Pension forecast from qualifying years. The reduced rate in section 3(2) of the Pensions Act 2014 is an image on legislation.gov.uk reading: 1/35 × the person's number of qualifying years.

fullRate.quote: The full rate of new State Pension is £241.30 a week.

tenYears.quote: You’ll need 10 qualifying years on your National Insurance record to get any new State Pension.

thirtyFive.quote: If your National Insurance record started after April 2016 you will need 35 qualifying years to get the full rate of new State Pension.

contractedOut.quote: If you were contracted out, you will usually need more than 35 qualifying years to get the full rate of new State Pension.

eachYear.quote: Each qualifying year after 6 April 2016 added to your National Insurance record increases your State Pension amount, up to the full rate ( £241.30 a week).

workAfter.quote: If you do, you’ll stop paying National Insurance

credits.quote: A qualifying year is one in which you were: working and made National Insurance contributions getting National Insurance credits for example if you were unemployed, ill or a parent or carer paying voluntary National Insurance contributions

different.quote: Your amount could be different depending on: if you were contracted out before 2016 the number of National Insurance qualifying years you have if you paid into the Additional State Pension before 2016

abroad.quote: You could still be eligible if you made contributions to the state pensions in: the European Economic Area ( EEA ) – this includes any country in the EU as well as Norway, Iceland and Liechtenstein Switzerland any country that has a social security agreement with the UK

paid.quote: The new State Pension is usually paid into your account every 4 weeks.

full35.quote: A person is entitled to a state pension payable at the full rate if— (a) the person has reached pensionable age, and (b) the person has 35 or more qualifying years.

reduced.quote: The reduced rate of the state pension for a person is the following proportion of the full rate

class3.quote: The rates for the 2026 to 2027 tax year are: £3.65 a week for Class 2 £18.40 a week for Class 3

sixYears.quote: You can only pay voluntary contributions for the past 6 years. The deadline is 5 April each year.

notAlways.quote: Voluntary contributions do not always increase your State Pension, for example if you were contracted out
